pr_body:
Fixes #71506.

There existed a race condition in `TestConnHealthTryDial` that resulted in
a call to `ConnHealthTryDial` occasionally not returning `ErrNoHeartbeat`,
causing an assertion failure. This patch fixes this by checking connection status
using `ConnHealth`. 

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/72301)

issue_context.title: rpc/nodedialer: TestConnHealthTryDial failed
issue_context.body:
rpc/nodedialer.TestConnHealthTryDial [failed](https://teamcity.cockroachdb.com/viewLog.html?buildId=3575732&tab=buildLog) with [artifacts](https://teamcity.cockroachdb.com/viewLog.html?buildId=3575732&tab=artifacts#/) on master @ [fbc092b88893bfe4adb5285924614bf8e5132e4f](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/commits/fbc092b88893bfe4adb5285924614bf8e5132e4f): ``` === RUN TestConnHealthTryDial I211013 03:41:25.182049 303 2@rpc/context.go:1045 [-] 23 dialing n1: 127.0.0.1:39225 (default) nodedialer_test.go:189: Error Trace: nodedialer_test.go:189 Error: Not equal: expected: *withstack.withStack(&withstack.withStack{ cause: &errutil.leafError{msg:"not yet heartbeated"}, stack: &withstack.stack{0x16b6290, 0x45978c, 0x459712, 0x459712, 0x44bae5, 0x482fc1}, }) actual : () Test: TestConnHealthTryDial I211013 03:41:25.184011 41 2@rpc/context.go:688 [-] 24 closing [{n1: 127.0.0.1:39225 (default)} {n0: 127.0.0.1:39225 (default)}] --- FAIL: TestConnHealthTryDial (0.03s) ```
Reproduce

To reproduce, try: ```bash make stressrace TESTS=TestConnHealthTryDial PKG=./pkg/rpc/nodedialer TESTTIMEOUT=5m STRESSFLAGS='-timeout 5m' 2>&1 ``` Parameters in this failure: - GOFLAGS=-json

/cc @cockroachdb/server erikgrinaker [This test on roachdash](https://roachdash.crdb.dev/?filter=status:open%20t:.*TestConnHealthTryDial.*&sort=title+created&display=lastcommented+project) | [Improve this report!](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/internal/issues) Epic CRDB-11087
comments: @cameronnunez can you seek supervision / guidance from @erikgrinaker
This just seems like a race in the test, where the assertion happens before the connection heartbeats. I wrote this test, so I'd be happy to clean it up.
@erikgrinaker in the interest of ownership transfer, it would be even better if you could teach cameron how to do this

review_comments:
Thanks, makes sense. But let's make sure the connection is actually closed first, by using `ConnHealth`:

```go
	// Make sure no connection exists yet, via ConnHealth().
	require.Equal(t, rpc.ErrNoConnection, nd.ConnHealth(staticNodeID, rpc.DefaultClass))
```
